labels.text: Section 2503(b)(1): the per-donee annual exclusion from taxable gifts. Only the unadjusted $10,000 statutory base is pinned (in force for gifts made in calendar years 1982 through 1998, before section 2503(b)(2)'s inflation adjustment starts running for gifts made in a calendar year after 1998). A post-1998 indexed figure is pinned only where the Revenue Procedure publishing it is pinned in `us.irc.inflation_adjustments` (2025: Rev. Proc. 2024-40; 2026: Rev. Proc. 2025-32). Years 1999-2024 remain gaps inside the coverage, so evaluation returns MISSING_PARAMETER_VALUE rather than a figure without a pinned source. See TECH-GAPS.md G81.
section 2503(b)(1): 'the first $10,000 of such gifts to such person shall not ... be included in the total amount of gifts made during such year'

Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.43(1): 'For calendar year 2025, the first $19,000 of gifts to any person (other than gifts of future interests in property) are not included in the total amount of taxable gifts under § 2503 made during that year'

Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.42(1): 'For calendar year 2026, the first $19,000 of gifts to any person (other than gifts of future interests in property) are not included in the total amount of taxable gifts under § 2503 made during that year'
